evals.prompt: Find all YAML files under the allowed directories containing 'timeout' and inspect lines 20 to 60 of the largest matching file without reading the whole file.
evals.expected_output: Calls list_allowed_directories first, uses search_files_content with pattern '*.yml' or '*.yaml' and query 'timeout' (or search_files + get_file_info), and reads lines 20-60 with read_file_lines (0-based offset 19, limit 41).
assertions: Calls list_allowed_directories to discover permitted roots
Uses search_files_content with glob pattern and query
Uses read_file_lines with 0-based offset and limit instead of dumping full file

evals.prompt: Update port 8080 to 9090 in config.toml inside the allowed workspace, previewing the diff first before applying.
evals.expected_output: Reads with read_text_file(with_line_numbers=true), calls edit_file with dryRun=true and edits=[{oldText, newText}] to preview the git-style diff, then applies edit_file (dryRun=false) and notes that -w/--allow-write must be enabled on the server.
assertions: Uses edit_file with oldText/newText instead of overwriting blindly with write_file

evals.prompt: Check for duplicate files larger than 1 MB in the shared archive folder and calculate its total human-readable size.
evals.expected_output: Calls find_duplicate_files with root_path, min_bytes=1048576 (note snake_case exclude_patterns if used), and calculate_directory_size with root_path and output_format='human-readable'.
assertions: Uses find_duplicate_files with root_path and min_bytes
Uses calculate_directory_size with root_path and output_format='human-readable'
